summary: Simple page-based permission system testing completed successfully. All 6 features tested and working: admin login returns permissions, Shield button visible on Yöneticiler page, permission modal with 7 switches, permission update saves to backend, menu filtering works, route protection works.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed auth.py to properly normalize old granular permissions to new simple format during login
Fixed admins.py GET /api/admins to return only simple permission keys instead of old granular format

tested_features.admin_login_permissions: PASS - Login response includes permissions field with 7 simple keys
tested_features.shield_button_visible: PASS - Shield (izin) button visible on Yöneticiler page for non-superadmin users
tested_features.permission_modal_7_switches: PASS - Modal shows 7 switches: Vardiyalar, Muhasebe, Zimmet, Kuryeler, Market, Akademi, Sistem Ayarları
tested_features.permission_update_saves: PASS - PUT /api/admins/{id}/permissions saves to database, verified via login
tested_features.menu_filtering: PASS - Restricted pages (Market, Akademi, Yöneticiler) hidden from menu for testpermadmin
tested_features.route_protection: PASS - Direct URL access to /admin/jetpuan and /admin/akademi shows blank content (no page rendered)

seed_data_creation: Created testpermadmin with restricted permissions (Market, Akademi, Sistem disabled)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Simple page-based permission system is fully working. 7 permission keys: vardiya, muhasebe, zimmet, kuryeler, market, akademi, sistem. Backend normalizes old granular permissions to simple format during login and GET /api/admins. Permission changes require re-login to take effect (no session invalidation).
